payload.summary: Subagent-driven-development workspaces are git-ignored, so a session's triage and review artefacts vanish at cleanup
payload.detail: The SDD skill writes its ledger, briefs, reports and review packages under .superpowers/sdd/, which .gitignore:175 ignores wholesale. Observed 2026-09-02: 1,853 lines of triage (24 findings with executable mutation specs) existed only there and would not have survived a clean; it was rescued by hand to docs/ward-flow/triage/ at 38f90d138. Two other chats reported the same exposure, one losing nine recorded rulings. Recommendation: either the skill's close-down step copies durable artefacts into a tracked path, or the workspace path is documented as ephemeral where sessions will actually read it. Not a defect in the skill; a mismatch between where it writes and how long its output is expected to matter.
